notes: Diagnostic prototype only: installable, productionPerformanceClaim and scalesSerialized are always false; no artifact, installation, promotion or default change.

realE4GateComplete is recomputed at encode time from the validated qualification receipt of THIS executable. gainQualified is recomputed from the raw runs: true only when every run of the fixed sequence passed its checks and every fixture met spread <= 5% per arm and gain >= 2%.

Both arms: same binary, runner, v1 E4R32 install, Q4 width 32 and declared modern candidate. OFF = control preparation with CPU routing; ON = device-routing preparation in one scope per run with captureSnapshots false (no CPU FP64 recompute or component replay in any timed run).

Each run is checked outside the timers: 32 frozen IDs, 32 full-vocabulary finite outputs, exact derived counters with every fallback 0, totals equal to the qualified OFF totals (OFF) or OFF + 30 kernels and OFF - 30 command buffers per forward (ON), pinned 1349/37 (OFF) and 1379/7 (ON) per continuation, CPU/GPU selection, record-chain and accepted-token counters, the qualified selector source and an intact install.
Command-buffer intervals are diagnostic only: not GPU busy time and never compared between arms.

Measured under the machine's actual normal concurrency: the tool neither waits for nor accepts a quiet acknowledgement; GO and the resource receipts before GO and after TIMED_WINDOW_END belong to the external supervisor. Progress lines between runs add journaling overhead outside the timers.
Model SHA-256 is the cached explicit-refresh record; this tool never hashes, re-verifies or downloads the model.

protocolSpec.exclusions: outside the timers only: model load, install, preparation, selector compile, scope entry and exit, counter snapshots, finiteness and ID checks, progress lines and report serialization; warmups are executed and checked but not used for statistics
protocolSpec.gpuElapsed: per-call command-buffer intervals (gpuEndTime - gpuStartTime) are recorded for diagnosis only; they are not GPU busy time and are never compared between arms or used by any decision
protocolSpec.outlierPolicy: none: every timed run is reported and used; no retry, rescue, reseed, adaptive stop, trimming, outlier drop or count change; any failed run check fails the protocol
protocolSpec.statistic: run TPOT = median of its 31 continuation walls; arm TPOT = median of its 7 timed run TPOTs per fixture; spread = (max - min) / median per arm per fixture, required <= 0.05; gain = (OFF - ON) / OFF per fixture, required >= 0.02 on every fixture
protocolSpec.timer: wall clock (DispatchTime uptime) around exactly one executeGraphContinue(previous actual argmax) call per continuation, 31 timers per run; each call includes encoding, GPU waits, command-buffer completion, the full-vocabulary logits readback and argmax, and for ON the runtime selector dispatches, the record-bound expert chains and the post-token record flag verification; prefill is timed separately around executeGraph(prompt) and is not TPOT
